description: On desktop, the app's own page may call the agent host through the agent_host_* commands: the shell starts the host for the profile and makes each call, so the launch token stays in the shell (crates/agent-host). The page names a route of the host's table, never a URL, and saves the sandbox choice only by naming a backend (agent_host_sandbox_choice_save), never a file. engine_ready tells the shell the page's engine is ready, which starts the host, and start_status answers how far Studio's start has got, as fixed values only (HAL-13408). It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no agent host.
